canvas.coordinateSemantics: Approximate screen-space zones and ground pivots for this flattened concept; measure exact collision footprints on separate sprites.

camera.description: Lett opphøgd hjørneperspektiv sett frå romopninga; veggar står loddrett, golvet er synleg, og alle sprites brukar den same kameraretninga.

spriteRules: All floor-object pivots touch the one shared floor plane; apparent size may decrease with depth.
All images use the same three-quarter camera profile, logical pixel scale, outline weight and upper-left light.
Keep vertical edges vertical. Do not rotate individual furniture to compensate for an incompatible drawing.
Place accessories by parent-local mounts and sort floor objects by their ground-contact y coordinate.
The reference image is a flattened layout concept. Reusable game furniture must be exported as separate sprites with measured alpha bounds, pivot, footprint and mounts.
